themes.flutlicht: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme='light']) and :root[data-theme='dark']; swaps RGB channels only

display.purpose: One cover H1 per page; Anpfiff and footer sign-offs.

title.purpose: H3, process step names, status headings.

label.purpose: Table heads, dt terms, process timing, footer column headings. Never above a heading.

board.purpose: Scoreboard values and header rubric only.

shadows.name: focus-ring-input
shadows.purpose: Input focus stroke; the only box-shadow. Not elevation.

motion.name: board-switch
motion.purpose: Header rubric change on scroll; never on first paint.

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.value: rotate(-9deg) scale(1.5) blur(2px) -> scale(0.96) -> scale(1), 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Button, input, chip, link colour changes.

motion.name: duration-nudge
motion.purpose: Nav underline scale-in, arrow translate-x 4px, FAQ plus rotate.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; smooth scroll only on no-preference.

components.name: button-signal
components.description: The one primary action per view. Press black on signal orange (5.8:1); hover inverts.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 24px; border: 2px solid; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 85%; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151614; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-signal { background: #ff5a1f; color: #151614; border-color: #151614; } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: #151614; color: #ff5a1f; border-color: #151614; }

components.name: button-ink
components.description: Secondary decisive action. Ink fill that empties on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 24px; border: 2px solid #151614; border-radius: 0; background: #151614; color: #f4f4ef; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 85%; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.15; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: transparent; color: #151614; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151614; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: button-outline
components.description: Tertiary or equal-weight alternative; current-colour frame, fills ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 24px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #151614; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 85%; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.15; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #151614; color: #f4f4ef; border-color: #151614; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151614; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: input
components.description: Square sheet field with 2px rule frame; focus adds an ink border and 2px ink ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-email">Ihre E-Mail-Adresse</label><input id="ds-email" class="ds-input" type="email" placeholder="name@firma.de">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 90%; color: #151614; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #848880; border-radius: 0; background: #fcfcf9; color: #151614; font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4a4d47; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #4a4d47; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #151614; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #151614; }

components.name: chip
components.description: Radio/checkbox as a printed box; checked fills ink.
components.html: <label class="ds-chip"><input type="radio" name="t" checked> Neue Website</label><label class="ds-chip"><input type="radio" name="t"> Online-Shop</label>
components.css: .ds-chip { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; margin: 0 8px 8px 0; border: 2px solid #151614; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 88%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #151614; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgb(21 22 20 / 0.06); } .ds-chip:has(input:checked) { background: #151614; color: #f4f4ef; } .ds-chip:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid #151614; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: nav
components.description: Sticky paper header, 2px ink base; uppercase condensed links with a 3px signal underline that scales in; rubric board beside the logo.
components.html:
Tabelle
LeistungenReferenzenPreise
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 24px; background: #f4f4ef; border-bottom: 2px solid #151614; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; margin-left: auto; } .ds-rubric { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 36px; min-width: 11.5rem; padding: 0 12px; background: #151614; color: #f4f4ef; font-family: 'Doto Variable', Doto, ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rubric i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5a1f; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; color: #151614; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 85%; font-weight: 720; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 6px; height: 3px; background: #ff5a1f; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.ds-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151614; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: scoreboard
components.description: Black dl of confirmed figures in Doto dot-matrix; field-soft labels below.
components.css: .ds-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); margin: 0; background: #151614; color: #f4f4ef; } .ds-board div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-board div + div { border-left: 1px solid rgb(244 244 239 / 0.2); } .ds-board dd { order: -1; margin: 0; font-family: 'Doto Variable', Doto, ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-board dt { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 88%; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #b9d3c3; }

components.name: section-head
components.description: 6px ink rule, condensed headline, ink-soft lead. Replaces eyebrow labels.
components.html:
So läuft’s ab.

Fünf Schritte, keine Überraschungen.
components.css: .ds-section-head { border-top: 6px solid #151614; padding-top: 32px; color: #151614; } .ds-section-head h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 820; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 0.98; letter-spacing: -0.012em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-section-head p { margin: 20px 0 0; max-width: 42rem; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.625; color: #4a4d47; }

components.name: ticket
components.description: Inquiry card: sheet with 2px ink frame, side notches and dashed perforation; overlaps the green cover edge.
components.css: .ds-ticket { --notch: 14px; --tear: 4.75rem; position: relative; max-width: 26rem; background: #fcfcf9; color: #151614; border: 2px solid #151614; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle var(--notch) at 0 var(--tear), transparent 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle var(--notch) at 100% var(--tear), transparent 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; mask: radial-gradient(circle var(--notch) at 0 var(--tear), transparent 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle var(--notch) at 100% var(--tear), transparent 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; } .ds-ticket-head { height: var(--tear); display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; } .ds-ticket-head h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 62%; font-weight: 880; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 0.95; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ticket-head span { display: block; color: #4a4d47; } .ds-ticket-tear { position: absolute; left: 24px; right: 24px; top: var(--tear); border-top: 2px dashed rgb(21 22 20 / 0.4); } .ds-ticket-body { position: relative; min-height: 8rem; padding: 28px 24px 24px; } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; right: 20px; top: 16px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 12px; border: 3px solid #b33a0a; color: #b33a0a; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 62%; font-weight: 880; font-size: 1.25rem; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-9deg); }

narrative.overview: The site is the printed programme for a home match: a green cover page, a league table of prices, a fixture list for the process, the home games as references, a personal foreword, and the kick-off ticket. Newsprint paper with a faint offset grain, press black, one solid field of turf green, and one signal orange reserved for doing something. Archivo at its narrowest width sets poster capitals; Doto dot matrix lives only on the scoreboard. Density is a programme's: heavy 6px rules, real numbers in tabular figures, depth only from overlapping framed layers. It rejects the dark-hero, glass-card, icon-tile agency template it replaced.
keyCharacteristics: Three inks: paper/ink, field green, signal orange
Square corners, 2px print frames, 6px section rules
Header scoreboard announces the current data-rubric
Flutlicht dark theme swaps RGB-channel tokens only

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: Paper/ink, field green, signal orange. No fourth hue, no tints beyond alpha on ink, no gradients.

rules.name: The Signal-Means-Act Rule
rules.body: Orange marks something you can do. Sole exception: the closing word of the home cover headline at display size.

rules.name: The Doto Stays on the Board Rule
rules.body: The dot-matrix face appears only inside bg-board (ScoreBoard, header rubric).

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tables and .tabular use tabular-nums so prices align like a league table.

rules.name: The Scherenschnitt Rule
rules.body: To lift something, overlap it and frame it. Never shadow, blur or glow it.

dos: Do open every section with SectionHead (6px ink rule + headline) and tag it with data-rubric.
Do keep targets at least 44px, and 48px for buttons and inputs.
Do use on-field / on-ink so text and --focus flip together; focus is a 3px solid outline offset 3px.
Do keep one btn-signal per view and pair alternatives at equal size.
Do hide icons from assistive tech and pair them with real text; announce new tabs via sr-only.
Do write in Ich-Form addressing the reader as Sie; state only confirmed facts.
Do alternate paper and sheet bands; start and end the page on field green.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a headline.
Don't build card grids of icon tiles.
Don't use gradients, glass, blur, or box-shadow for depth.
Don't set Doto outside the scoreboard and header rubric.
Don't use signal orange for anything that is not an action (except the one cover word).
Don't invent testimonials, client counts, awards or team members; no portrait photo.
